battle.name: 廓藏戰爭
battle.brief: 一八五五年三月，尼泊爾首相章巴·拉納以使團受辱與克蒂邊界爭端為由向西藏宣戰，四月初分克榮、克蒂、馬斯塘三路越過山口，投入二萬七千人、三十六門砲與八門迫擊砲。卡面這門一八五〇年的德意志線膛野戰砲代表射程革命，但遠征帶上山的仍是前裝滑膛銅砲，扭轉戰局的是章卡攻堅九天與藏軍雪季反攻。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰的兩邊都不是主權國家，而是廓爾喀王國與清朝屬地的甘丹頗章政府。尼泊爾一方是加德滿都的拉納家族新政權，首相章巴·拉納自一八四六年政變後掌權，遠征軍以家族將領分軸編制：克榮軸由巴姆·巴哈杜爾·庫瓦統帥，兵力二萬五千七百二十八人；克蒂軸由迪爾·順謝爾·拉納統帥，四千六百七十八人；霍姆拉與馬斯塘一路由克里希那·多吉·庫瓦率二千五百人；俄朗仲古拉一路由普里特維·多吉·庫瓦上校率二千人，四路合計約二萬七千人，攜帶三十六門砲與八門迫擊砲，另有運彈藥、糧秣與傷兵的騾馬與背夫。西藏一方是拉薩的甘丹頗章政府，名義上受清朝保護，實由達賴喇嘛衙門與策林第巴等僧俗官員調度，總指揮色提亞·卡吉麾下約五萬人，其中八千人布於迪加爾查前線，四萬人集中定日一線，分別駐守關隘、寺院城堡與河谷渡口。清廷是背後的第三方，咸豐朝正被太平天國與捻軍牽制，遠離京畿的邊區兵力有限，直到一八五五年底才下令自內地調二千官兵入藏。英屬印度是廓爾喀的近鄰與事後的仲裁者，駐尼泊爾公使C.E.R.吉德爾斯通把這場戰爭的開支與損失一一記在往來信件裡。
countriesEn: The two sides were not sovereign states but the Kingdom of Nepal and the Ganden Phodrang government of Tibet, then a Qing protectorate. The Nepalese side was the new Rana regime at Kathmandu: prime minister Jang Bahadur Rana had held power since the coup of 1846, and the invading army was organised into separate axes commanded by members of his own family. The Kerong axis under Bam Bahadur Kunwar numbered 25,728 men, the Kuti axis under Dhir Shumsher Rana 4,678, the Humla and Mustang sector under Krishna Dhoj Kunwar 2,500, and the Olangchunggola axis under Colonel Prithvi Dhoj Kunwar 2,000; the four together came to some 27,000 men, carrying thirty-six guns and eight mortars, together with the mules and porters who moved ammunition, grain and wounded. The Tibetan side was the government at Lhasa, nominally under Qing protection and in practice directed by the Dalai Lama's office and the monastic and lay officials around it. Sethya Kaji commanded about 50,000 men, of whom 8,000 were posted on the Digarcha front and 40,000 were concentrated around Tingri, holding in turn the passes, the monastery fortresses and the river crossings. The Qing court was the third party behind Tibet: the Xianfeng government was tied down by the Taiping and Nian rebellions and had few troops for a frontier far from the capital, and it was not until the end of 1855 that it ordered two thousand officers and soldiers to be sent inland to reinforce Tibet. British India stood next door to Nepal and afterwards arbitrated the matter; the British Resident in Nepal, C. E. R. Girdlestone, recorded the cost of the war and its losses in his correspondence.
people: 尼泊爾方面，首相章巴·拉納是這場戰爭的推手：一八五一年他曾率團遊歐，見過歐洲的槍砲與制度；一八五五年三月他以拉薩接待一八五二年使團失禮、尼泊爾新瓦里商人被勒索、克蒂一帶邊界爭端為由下最後通牒，限四月十七日前答應割地賠款。他的弟弟迪爾·順謝爾·拉納任克蒂軸主將，四月三日於察烏楚擊敗一股小股藏軍，不折一卒而奪下克蒂與蘇納寺，被章巴譽為妙手；十一月五日藏軍夜襲克蒂大營，他損失約七百人，十二月靠增援多面夾擊收復克蒂，焚城而退至利提，並在利提附近的杜古納村設下後勤基地。克榮軸主將巴姆·巴哈杜爾·庫瓦不戰而取克榮，進軍庫庫爾山口後在章卡攻堅九天；霍姆拉與馬斯塘一路的克里希那·多吉·庫瓦、俄朗仲古拉一路的普里特維·多吉·庫瓦上校各守一翼。藏方以色提亞·卡吉統五萬之眾，卻未能集中兵力；冬季反攻的實際策劃者是卡隆·沙拉；蘇納寺的守軍有八千人，章卡守軍被圍後由薩納克·辛格·卡特里上校解圍。清朝一線由駐藏大臣主持外交，一八五六年一月西藏代表與清使同赴加德滿都談判，最後由章巴在三月廿四日於塔帕塔利定約。
peopleEn: On the Nepalese side the driving figure was the prime minister, Jang Bahadur Rana. He had travelled to Europe with a mission in 1851 and had seen European guns and institutions at first hand; in March 1855 he issued an ultimatum on the ground that Lhasa had received the mission of 1852 discourteously, that Nepalese Newar traders were being extorted, and that a boundary dispute was outstanding around Kuti, setting 17 April as the deadline for a grant of land and compensation. His brother Dhir Shumsher Rana commanded the Kuti axis, defeated a small Tibetan detachment at Chusan on 3 April, took Kuti and Suna Gompa without losing a man, and was praised by Jang Bahadur for the feat; when the Tibetans struck his camp at Kuti by night on 5 November he lost about seven hundred men, and in December he retook Kuti with reinforcements pressing in from several directions, burned the town and withdrew to Listi, having established a logistics base at the village of Duguna near Listi. Bam Bahadur Kunwar, who commanded the Kerong axis, took Kerong without a fight, pushed through Kukurghat and fought for nine days at Dzongka; Krishna Dhoj Kunwar in the Humla and Mustang sector and Colonel Prithvi Dhoj Kunwar on the Olangchunggola axis each held one flank. For Tibet, Sethya Kaji had 50,000 men against 27,000 but could not concentrate them; the real author of the winter offensive was Kalon Shatra; the fortress of Suna Gompa was held by 8,000 men, and the siege of Dzongka was relieved by Colonel Sanak Singh Khatri. On the Chinese side, diplomacy in Lhasa was in the hands of the amban, and in January 1856 a Tibetan delegation with a Chinese envoy travelled to Kathmandu, where the terms were finally agreed on 24 March at Thapathali.
kits: 卡面這門一八五〇年的德意志線膛野戰砲在這場戰爭裡沒有出現過，也不可能出現。線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠，砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵，這是十九世紀中葉歐洲正在推開的變革；而一八五五年尼泊爾遠征軍帶上喜馬拉雅山口的三十六門砲，仍是前裝滑膛的銅砲與鐵砲，另配八門迫擊砲，口徑不大，射程有限，拆裝要靠騾牛分載，展開一次便要半日，攻蘇納寺、章卡這類寺院城堡時往往只能壓制城牆而不能拆毀牆基。藏軍的裝備更舊：步兵是火繩槍配長刀，關隘與寺院用少量清廷頒發或本地鑄造的銅砲，後方近拉薩的火力稍強，卻運不上高山，冬季封路即成廢鐵。尼泊爾步兵同樣用燧發滑膛步槍配刺刀，火藥與彈藥靠騾馬與人力背夫運過山口，糧秣由加德滿都經熱拉、克蒂一線接應；冬天的暴雪讓火繩難以點燃、凍住的槍機難以擊發，火力在幾天之內可以等於零，遠征軍那三十八門火器因此不是勝敗的關鍵，山口與糧秣才是。
kitsEn: The German rifled field gun of 1850 on this card never appeared in this war and could not have done so. Rifling let the same charge travel further, and artillery could for the first time outrange infantry in a duel; that was the change Europe was pushing through in the middle of the nineteenth century. The thirty-six guns the Nepalese expedition carried over the Himalayan passes in 1855 were still smoothbore muzzle-loaders of brass and iron, with eight mortars besides; they were of modest calibre and short range, had to be carried in parts on mules, and took half a day to deploy, so against a monastery fortress such as Suna Gompa or Dzongka they could generally only shell the wall and never breach its base. The Tibetans were equipped more old-fashioned still: infantry with matchlock muskets and long swords, and a few bronze guns at the passes and monasteries, supplied by the Qing or cast locally. The firepower near Lhasa was stronger but could not be brought up into the high mountains, and once the winter roads closed it was so much dead weight. Nepalese infantry carried flintlock smoothbore muskets with bayonets in the same way; powder and shot came over the passes on mules and on the backs of porters, and the grain was fed from Kathmandu by way of Jara and Kuti. In the blizzards of winter a match could hardly be lit and a frozen lock could hardly be fired, so the firepower of an army could be worth nothing within days. The thirty-eight pieces the expedition carried were therefore not what decided the war; the passes and the food were.
tactics: 這場高山戰爭的節奏完全由山口、寺院堡壘與雪季決定。尼泊爾四月初同時越過瓦隆仲至熱拉一線的多個山口，以克榮軸人數最多、進展最遠，沿克榮溝北進，先取克榮，再打庫庫爾山口，最後在章卡與藏軍對攻九天，藏軍退守定日才算收兵；克蒂軸四月初以奇襲取克蒂、逼退蘇納寺守軍，戰果雖大，卻沒有解決章卡一線的正面堡壘。五月至九月，雙方在什卡爾仲一帶談判僵持，尼泊爾沒有力氣再打一次攻勢，藏方卻有自己的算盤。十一月五日，卡隆·沙拉指揮藏軍以兩支隊伍同時夜襲克蒂與章卡的尼泊爾營地，卡在雪季封山這個時機上：尼泊爾軍在克蒂損失約七百人，倖存者退回邊境，章卡的守軍反被包圍；十二月迪爾·順謝爾靠增援多面夾擊收復克蒂，焚城後退回利提，章卡之圍由薩納克·辛格·卡特里解開。整體而言，多路分進、以寺廟與渡口設防、靠火繩槍與冷兵器近身決鬥、避免在冬季主動出擊，是雙方共同的經驗；最後把談判推到成交的，是尼泊爾國庫見底與清廷調兵這兩件事。
tacticsEn: The rhythm of this high-altitude war was set entirely by the passes, the monastery fortresses and the winter. Early in April the Nepalese crossed several passes in one stroke along the line from Walungchung to Jara. The Kerong axis had the most men and went furthest, driving north up the Kerong valley, taking Kerong, forcing Kukurghat and finally fighting the Tibetans for nine days at Dzongka, the Tibetan retreat to Tingri ending the operation; the Kuti axis struck by surprise on 3 April, taking Kuti and driving off the garrison of Suna Gompa, a success that nevertheless left the strong positions of the Dzongka line untouched. From May to September the talks at Shikarjong dragged on without settlement: Nepal had neither the means nor the men for another offensive, while Tibet still had cards to play. On 5 November Kalon Shatra sent two Tibetan columns simultaneously against the Nepalese camps at Kuti and Dzongka, choosing the moment when the passes were closing under snow. The Nepalese lost about seven hundred men at Kuti and the survivors fled back to the border, while the garrison at Dzongka was invested in turn. In December Dhir Shumsher retook Kuti with reinforcements pressing in from several directions, burned the town and withdrew to Listi, and the siege of Dzongka was relieved by Sanak Singh Khatri. In general both sides had learned the same lessons: advance by several axes, defend at monasteries and crossings, decide the business at close quarters with matchlocks and cold steel, and avoid taking the offensive in winter. What finally pushed the negotiations to a settlement was the emptying of the Nepalese treasury and the movement of Qing troops.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。尼泊爾遠征軍四路合計約二萬七千人，配三十六門砲與八門迫擊砲：克榮軸二萬五千七百二十八人，克蒂軸四千六百七十八人，霍姆拉與馬斯塘二千五百人，俄朗仲古拉一軸二千人。藏軍總數約五萬人，其中迪加爾查前線八千人，定日一線四萬人；蘇納寺的守軍為八千人。時間線上，章巴·拉納於一八五五年三月下最後通牒，限期四月十七日，遠征於四月初開始，五月至九月談判未果，十一月五日藏軍發動冬季反攻，十二月尼泊爾收復克蒂，一八五六年一月西藏代表與清使抵加德滿都，三月廿四日於塔帕塔利簽約。錢的數目最關鍵：尼泊爾原索賠一千萬盧比，最後降為每年一萬盧比，首期一次付清五萬零一盧比；迪爾·順謝爾向英國駐尼泊爾公使估計，再打一場要再多花六千萬盧比，超出尼泊爾能從拉薩索取的補償。清廷一八五五年底下令自內地調二千官兵入藏。各家記錄互有出入，引用時應保留這些出入。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The Nepalese expedition numbered about 27,000 men on four axes, with thirty-six guns and eight mortars: 25,728 on the Kerong axis, 4,678 on the Kuti axis, 2,500 in the Humla and Mustang sector and 2,000 on the Olangchunggola axis. The Tibetan force was about 50,000 men, of whom 8,000 held the Digarcha front and 40,000 were concentrated around Tingri; the fortress of Suna Gompa was held by 8,000 men. In time, Jang Bahadur Rana delivered his ultimatum in March 1855 with 17 April as the deadline, the invasion opened in early April, the negotiations from May to September came to nothing, the Tibetan winter offensive was launched on 5 November, the Nepalese retook Kuti in December, a Tibetan delegation with a Chinese envoy reached Kathmandu in January 1856, and the treaty was signed at Thapathali on 24 March. Money is the crucial figure: Nepal had demanded ten million rupees, and the sum was finally reduced to ten thousand rupees a year, with a first payment of 50,001 rupees paid at once. Dhir Shumsher told the British Resident in Nepal that another campaign would cost Nepal sixty lakhs of rupees more than it could ever hope to extract from Lhasa. At the end of 1855 the Qing court ordered two thousand officers and soldiers to be sent inland to reinforce Tibet. The accounts of the different sides do not agree exactly, and those differences should be preserved when the figures are quoted.
cause: 動因有三層。最表層是幾樁被拿來當藉口的事：一八五二年尼泊爾遣使赴拉薩，回程與在藏期間的待遇被指為受輕慢；拉薩對尼泊爾新瓦里商人的徵收與刁難被列為罪狀；克蒂一帶的邊界與草場歸屬爭議被說成是藏方越界。這三件事本身並不致命，卻被拿去包裝一次以割地賠款為目的的進攻。第二層是尼泊爾自身的政治需要：章巴·拉納一八四六年掌權後正在把廓爾喀的國家機器重新握緊，一八五一年遊歐之後又對近代火砲與財政有了新的指望，軍功與新得的邊境地盤可以安撫國內反對者，也可以向英屬印度與清朝證明尼泊爾並非只能服從。第三層是國際條件：一八五〇年代太平天國與捻軍把清朝的兵與財拖在內地，英屬印度對廓藏既無實際控制也無餘力介入，章巴因此判定即使越過喜馬拉雅也不致招來有效干涉，於是把一八五五年三月當成出手的時機。西藏方面也有自己的算盤：清廷鞭長莫及，藏軍人多而山路熟，尼泊爾的後方卻在加德滿都，遠征的糧秣與人命都要從那裡補。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. On the surface there were a few grievances used as pretexts: the reception of the Nepalese mission to Lhasa in 1852 was said to have been discourteous and the envoys ill treated on the way home; the exactions and obstructions suffered by Nepalese Newar traders in Lhasa were put on the list; and a dispute over the boundary and the grazing lands around Kuti was presented as Tibetan aggression. None of these was in itself fatal, but they were used to dress up an invasion whose real purpose was land and compensation. The second layer was the political need of Nepal itself: after taking power in 1846, Jang Bahadur Rana was tightening his grip on the machinery of the Gurkha state, and after his journey to Europe in 1851 he had new expectations of modern artillery and of finances; a military victory and fresh frontier territory would quiet the opposition at home and show British India and Qing China that Nepal was not a state that only obeyed. The third layer was the international condition: in the 1850s the Taiping and Nian rebellions were draining Qing troops and money away from the interior, and British India had neither actual control over Tibet nor the means to intervene, so Jang Bahadur judged that an advance beyond the Himalaya would meet no effective resistance, and chose March 1855 as the moment to move. Tibet had its own arithmetic in turn: the Qing court could not reach, the Tibetan host was numerous and knew the mountains, while the Nepalese rear lay at Kathmandu, from which every load of grain and every man of the expedition had to be supplied.
impact: 後果分四層。對尼泊爾，短期是財政重創：國庫被進軍與佔領吃空，反戰聲浪在國內上升，遠征軍既無士氣也無補給再打一個攻勢，章巴不得不把索賠砍到象徵性的年度一萬盧比，並放棄一切領土要求。對西藏，邊界第一次以條約形式固定下來，尼泊爾歸還所佔的龍、尼亞木、章卡、布朗、榮竹一帶土地，並歸還俘虜與被奪的砲位；但代價是每年向尼泊爾付出一萬盧比，容許尼泊爾在拉薩設商站與常駐官員，尼泊爾商人還免徵商稅與路稅，這在西藏的財政與主權觀念上都是新的讓步。對清朝，咸豐朝被迫在太平天國之外再操心西南邊疆，被迫自內地調兵，而調兵本身也暴露了邊防的虛弱，此後清廷對藏邊的經營更倚賴駐藏大臣與地方僧官。對南亞與英屬印度，尼泊爾在對清交涉中換來實惠，地位上升，一八五七年印度起義時更出兵三千人赴勒克瑙等地助英平亂，英國對尼泊爾的態度因此改變，到一九二三年才以條約正式承認其獨立主權。
impactEn: The consequences came in four layers. For Nepal the immediate effect was financial ruin: the treasury was emptied by the invasion and the occupation, opposition to the war rose at home, and the expedition had neither the morale nor the supply to mount another offensive, so Jang Bahadur had to cut the indemnity to the token annual payment of ten thousand rupees and drop all territorial claims. For Tibet the frontier was fixed for the first time by treaty: Nepal returned the ground it had occupied around Long, Nyalam, Tsongkha, Blang and Rongju, and gave back prisoners and captured gun positions; the price was an annual payment of ten thousand rupees to Nepal, the right for Nepal to keep a trading station and a resident official at Lhasa, and exemption for Nepalese traders from commercial and road taxes, all of them new concessions in Tibetan fiscal and sovereign terms. For the Qing court, the Xianfeng government had to worry about a south-western frontier in addition to the Taiping, was obliged to move troops out of the interior, and the movement itself exposed the weakness of the border, so that from then on Qing authority in Tibet leaned more on the amban and the local monastic officials. For South Asia and British India, Nepal had gained real advantage from the negotiations and rose in standing; in 1857, during the Indian Mutiny, it sent three thousand men to Lucknow and elsewhere to help Britain put the rising down, which changed the British attitude towards Nepal, and it was not until 1923 that a British treaty formally recognised Nepal's independent sovereignty.
result: 結果是雙方都沒拿到想要的東西。一八五五年四月的夏季攻勢，尼泊爾越過多個山口，奪取克蒂與克榮，在章卡攻堅九天逼退藏軍至定日，看似順利；五月至九月的談判卻在什卡爾仲一帶一再破裂，尼泊爾索賠一千萬盧比與割地的要求始終無法落實。十一月五日的冬季反攻才是戰局轉折：藏軍卡隆·沙拉以雪季為掩護，同時夜襲克蒂與章卡，尼泊爾軍在克蒂損失約七百人，倖存者退回邊境；十二月迪爾·順謝爾收復克蒂、焚城退回利提，章卡之圍由薩納克·辛格·卡特里上校解開，雙方回到出發前的分界線附近。一八五六年三月廿四日，條約在加德滿都近郊的塔帕塔利簽訂：藏方每年付一萬盧比並一次性先付五萬零一盧比，允許尼泊爾在拉薩設商站與代表機構，歸還土地、俘虜與砲位，尼泊爾則放棄領土要求。從兵器看，這是一場前裝滑膛砲與火繩槍在高海拔山區的最後一場大規模較量之一；卡面那門一八五〇年的線膛野戰砲所象徵的射程革命，要到線膛真正壓倒滑膛之後，才會出現在這一帶的山口上。
resultEn: The result was that neither side got what it wanted. In the summer offensive of April 1855 the Nepalese crossed several passes, took Kuti and Kerong and fought for nine days at Dzongka, driving the Tibetans back to Tingri, and it looked like success; but the negotiations from May to September broke down again and again at Shikarjong, and the Nepalese demand for ten million rupees and for territory was never satisfied. The winter offensive of 5 November was the real turning point: Kalon Shatra took the snow as cover and struck at Kuti and Dzongka at the same time, the Nepalese lost about seven hundred men at Kuti and the survivors ran back to the border; in December Dhir Shumsher retook Kuti, burned it and withdrew to Listi, and the siege of Dzongka was relieved by Colonel Sanak Singh Khatri, leaving both sides close to the line from which they had started. On 24 March 1856 the treaty was signed at Thapathali, on the outskirts of Kathmandu: Tibet was to pay ten thousand rupees a year with a lump sum of 50,001 rupees paid in advance, to allow a Nepalese trading station and agency at Lhasa, and to return the land, the prisoners and the gun positions, while Nepal dropped its territorial claims. Judged by its arms, this was one of the last large-scale contests in the high mountains between smoothbore muzzle-loaders and matchlocks; the revolution in range typified by the rifled field gun of 1850 on this card would only reach the passes of this region once rifling had genuinely beaten the smoothbore.
